scope: Public-safe source and method inventory; no private data
assurance: GitHub repository metadata and targeted README/source-path inspection only; no code execution, benchmark, security audit, trading simulation or edge validation; upstream heads as sampled and can change.

rows.method: Read-only EVM contract and EOA wallet buy/approve/sell comparison, adversarial simulation traps
rows.test: First verify native Robinhood chain4663 compatibility (not present in upstream built-in chain registry) and eth_simulateV1 node capability; upstream EOA path is Uniswap V2-only. Only when feasible compare same-block same-token EOA vs contract, sized full exits 100/500/1000 USD; never treat unsupported as SAFE.
rows.risk: Upstream chains.js does not list Robinhood 4663; EOA path uses Uniswap V2 routers only, no V4 callback; eth_simulateV1 support unverified on Robinhood RPC. Native 4663 may require original-owner adapter; no automatic code deployment.

rows.method: Perturb backtests and compare re-evaluated indicator/entry/exit values to detect lookahead
rows.test: Run independent no-future-data challenge on existing forecast inputs and original as-of boundaries, with false alarms and no future-leak controls
rows.risk: GPL reuse review; existing PIT checks already exist; do not fork a bot or assume its backtester is ground truth

rows.method: State override TrustSim read-only buy+sell, exit-now, pool and creator/owner checks, V2/v4 quote comparison

rows.test: Offline replay then opt-in bounded read-only provider latency/coverage clock trial; no scheduler until original approval
rows.risk: Transport providers may require paid gRPC and access; realtime speed does not imply population completeness

rows.method: Local-first fund-flow graph, transfer-linked evidence and explicit partial coverage; read-only agent/CLI patterns
rows.test: Against original wallet graph receipts, distinguish CEX hub from common ownership and count UNKNOWN coverage

rows.method: Geyser gRPC slot/tx/account event stream and standardized notification semantics

rows.risk: GPL obligations, API changes and venue-specific partial coverage; source entry not authorized
